_meta.description: Golden retrieval eval set for the chargeback-encyclopedia knowledge base. Built to establish a Recall@5/Recall@10/MRR baseline on the current whole-document embedding index BEFORE the chunking migration, so the migration's effect can be measured rather than assumed.
_meta.keyed_by: document title (as returned by /search) — will migrate to a stable document_id once chunking introduces one
_meta.relevance_scale: 3 = primary/best answer, 2 = clearly relevant secondary source, 1 = tangentially relevant. Only queries with more than one entry in `relevance` are graded (nDCG-eligible); single-answer queries are evaluated with Recall@K + MRR only.
